newsitem.title: GREECE: SOME BANKS STOP PROMISSORY NOTES TO GREEK BROKERS.
newsitem.headline: SOME BANKS STOP PROMISSORY NOTES TO GREEK BROKERS.

text.p: Some Greek and foreign banks were growing cautious of a bourse settlement row that halted trading today and had decided to stop issuing promissory notes to brokerages for the time being, bankers told Reuters.
"Of course, we have decided to stop issuing promissory notes to brokerages as of today following what is going on," said a high-level banker at a foreign bank.

Long delays in the delivery of treasuries in physical form, on average three months, from the printing unit of the central bank following an order from the finance ministry has made it necessary for brokerages to obtain bank promissory notes instead.
Some bankers expressed concern that some cash-strapped brokerages could seek to cash in their bond holdings. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
